title: New Godzilla Minus Zero Trailer Reveals First Full Look at New Sequel – Watch Now
content:
Godzilla Minus Zero is coming to screens worldwide with its highly anticipated sequel later this Fall , and a new trailer is showing off the first full look at what to expect from the big movie. Toho’s Godzilla franchise has reached a new apex as with the celebration of its 70th anniversary, Godzilla Minus One ended up being the most critically and commercially successful film in that long history. So it was no surprise to find out that Toho was quick to come back to screens with an official sequel.

Godzilla Minus Zero has been sharing brief looks at the sequel for the past few months , but they have unfortunately shown very little about what to expect from the new story. Taking place a couple of years after the events of Godzilla Minus One , now fans have gotten the first proper look at the sequel with a full trailer revealing the most details we have gotten about its new story thus far. You can check out the trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero below.

When Does Godzilla Minus Zero Come Out?

Godzilla Minus Zero is truly going to be a worldwide release in a way that no other Godzilla franchise film has done before. Toho and GKIDS are closely collaborating on its theatrical debut, and it’s going to release first in Japan on November 3rd. It’s then going to have a very quick turnaround for its international release as Godzilla Minus Zero will then be releasing across theaters in the United States and Canada on November 6th . That’s just proof positive that this is going to be a very big deal.

To further emphasize just how big of a deal this is going to be, Godzilla Minus Zero is also the first ever Japanese production to be fully filmed for IMAX. The film is going all out with the sequel as Takashi Yamazaki, director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor for Godzilla Minus One , returns to oversee it all for Toho Studios with ROBOT producing and SHIROGUMI Inc. behind the visual effects. The director has been teasing fans about what’s next for the story , and the main thing he seems to emphasize is the fact that Godzilla returning after such a short time is ultimately going to be the most horrific element of it all.

What’s Godzilla Minus Zero About?

Godzilla Minus Zero takes place in 1949, two years after the events of Godzilla Minus One . Fans saw in that first film as Ryunosuke Kamiki’s Koichi Shikishima had been in the midst of a ruined Japan that was recovering from the effects of World War II. Godzilla’s sudden appearance only served to make things worse, and that’s likely going to be doubly the case for its return two years after the fact. But while they were able to subdue Godzilla before, it likely won’t be as easy the second time around.

We’re going to see other returning members of the first film’s cast, and it’s likely their lives are going to be also thrown into chaos once more with Minami Hamabe as Noriko Oishi, Hidetaka Yoshioka as Kenji Noda, Yuki Yamada as Shiro Mizushima, Kuranosuke Sasaki as Seiji Akitsu, Sakura Ando as Sumiko Ota, and Miou Tanaka as Tatsuo Hotta all confirmed thus far. There might even be another threat lingering in it all , so definitely keep an eye out this Fall when it hits.

title: Ace of the Diamond Act II Season 2 Cour 2 New Key Visual Teases Seido vs Inashiro Match Ahead of October 11 Premiere
content:
Ace of the Diamond Act II Season 2 revealed a new key visual for its second cour, set to continue with the Seido vs Inashiro match on October 11, 2026. Taking over from Madhouse is studio OLM, which is animating the sequel with Hideaki Oba as the director. The full staff includes:

• Director: Hideaki Oba

• Series Composition: Kenji Konuta

• Screenplay: Kenji Konuta, Junichi Fujisaku, Takahiro Udagawa

• Character Design: Yasukazu Shoji

• Music: Gen Ittetsu

• Art Director: Kenji Kato

• Director of Photography: Atsushi Sato (Studio Shamrock)

• Color Design: Nao Sato

• Editing: Toshihiko Kojima

• Animation Production: OLM Team Yoshioka

It was previously announced that GLAY will perform the opening theme, while OxT will perform the ending theme for the second cour. Both artists previously contributed songs to the anime.

Crunchyroll is streaming the anime, with thirteen episodes out so far. You can watch the trailer below.

The returning voice cast for the anime includes:

• Takahiro Sakurai as Kazuya Miyuki

• Ryota Osaka as Eijun Sawamura

• Natsuki Hanae as Haruichi Kominato

• Nobunaga Shimazaki as Satoru Furuya

• Shintaro Asanuma as Yoichi Kuramochi

• Yuma Uchida as Koshu Okumura

• Daiki Yamashita as Takuma Seto

• Shunsuke Takeuchi as Masashi Yuki

• Ayumu Murase as Kaoru Yui

• Tasuku Hatanaka as Hirofumi Asada

Ace of the Diamond is a Japanese baseball manga written and illustrated by Yuji Terajima. It was serialized in Kodansha’s Weekly Shonem Magazine from May 2006 to January 2015. The sequel titled Ace of the Diamond Act II started in August 2015 and ran until October 2022. The series also received a TV anime adaptation by Madhouse x Production I.G which ran from October 2013 to March 2016 for a total of 126 episodes. An anime adaptation of Ace of Diamond Act II by Madhouse then aired from April 2019 to March 2020 for 52 episodes. The sequel was announced in May 2024.

Crunchyroll describes the story: Eijun Sawamura finally makes his first appearance at the spring invitational! He wants to restore Seido’s reputation as a first-rate team and make them national champions! Seido High School Baseball Club’s new run is about to begin!

title: Magic Repo Man Anime Unveils New Trailer, Theme Songs, Additional Cast
content:
The new trailer for Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest anime unveils the opening and ending theme songs of the series and an additional cast member. BUDDiiS performs the opening theme song “Risk rate,” while Kotani performs the ending theme song “Iremono.” Daisuke Namikawa joins the cast as Roger. SynergySP is animating the series slated to premiere on October 3.

Takahiro Tamano is directing, with Ryusuke Mori in charge of the series composition and Kazue Mori designing the characters. Ko Otani ( Shadow of the Colossus and Mobile Suit Gundam Wing ) is composing the music. A visual was released last June. The main cast includes:

• Reiji Kawashima as Lent

• Emiri Kato as Empee, the fairy companion

• Daiki Hamano as Guy

• Akira Sekine as Misa

• Yu Kobayashi as Elle

The anime is based on the manga by Shingo Iijima and original story by Masakichi. The story is introduced as follows: This is a world where a person’s life is greatly shaped by the “Gift” bestowed upon them by the Creator God. A kind-hearted boy named Lent, who lives in a remote frontier village, receives an exceedingly rare support-type ability called 《Mana Vault》, which allows him to lend his own magical power to his companions. Together with his childhood friends from the village, he forms the adventuring party “Skycleaver Sword” and sets out on a journey, determined to fulfill his role as the team’s support specialist. However, because Lent never seems to grow stronger himself, he comes to be seen as dead weight and is mercilessly expelled from the party. Consumed by intense anger and a desire for revenge, Lent’s Gift evolves, awakening its true power… A skill that allows him to forcibly reclaim the vast amounts of magical power he had been lending all along. Seizing back the mana from the former comrades who betrayed him, Lent grows stronger from what he recovers. Thus begins the tale of Lent’s revenge. Source: Official Website © Masakichi, Shingo Iijima, Flex Comix / “Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest” Production Committee

title: Hotel Inhumans Season 2 Reveals New Visual, Trailer, Theme Songs
content:
The previously announced Hotel Inhumans Season 2 revealed a new visual and trailer featuring the opening and ending theme songs on Tuesday. GAN performs the opening theme song, “Rasen,” and Phantom Siita sings the ending theme song, “Sweet Pea.” The anime is slated to begin on October 4.

The cast includes:

• Yusuke Kobayashi as Ikuro Hoshi

• Hinano Shirahama as Sara Haizaki

• Hina Youmiya as Shiba Kirihara

The trailer is region-locked as of this writing.

Tetsuro Amino returns to direct the sequel with Shoji Yonemura handling the series composition, Shingo Fujisaka designing the characters, and Koharu composing the music. Studio Bridge and AISLE are animating the series.

The official website describes the synopsis as follows: The finest hotels meet certain conditions: “exquisite cuisine,” “supreme relaxation,” “enticing entertainment”… and “arrangement of the latest weapons,” “secure identity falsification,” “flawless body disposal”—!? At this hotel, the guests are assassins, and serving them is a concierge who will never say “NO.” What are the desires of these inhumans (those who are not truly human)—the assassins—expressed on the edge of life and death? The curtain rises on a striking killing-hotel drama!

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Third Opening Featuring "DIVE TO WORLD" by CHERRYBLOSSOM
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its third opening, featuring the song “DIVE TO WORLD” by CHERRYBLOSSOM. The song was used in Episodes 52-73, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the fourth ending featuring “friend” by IDOLING!!! . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the second entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!
author: Anime Corner

title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden Anime's 2nd Video Unveils More Cast, Half-Year Run
content:
The staff for the television anime of Umikaze Minamino 's Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ( Kyōran Reijō Nia Liston: Byōjaku Reijō ni Tenseishita Kami-goroshi no Bujin no Kareinaru Musō Roku ) light novel series revealed on Tuesday the anime's second promotional video, four more cast members, and its broadcast run of two consecutive cours (quarters of a year). The new video previews the previously announced opening theme song "Respawn!!" by VTuber Tsunomaki Watame.

The newly announced cast members are:

Kōichi Sakaguchi as Bendelio

Junichi Suwabe as Hyurence Altoire

Maaya Uchida as Sharro White

Kazuyuki Okitsu as Asuma

J-Novel Club releases the novels digitally and describes the story:

A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different...But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she's got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she's in fighting form. Now that she's been given a second shot at life, however, she's determined to get what she wants. She's going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

The anime stars:

• Honoka Inoue as Nia Liston

• Fūka Izumi as Rinokis Funk

• Rina Honnizumi as Hildetora Altoir

• Rina Hidaka as Reliared Silver

• Taku Yashiro as Anzel

• Yōko Hikasa as Fressa

• Satoshi Hino as Gandolf Rogen

Motoki Nakanishi ( Love Is Indivisible by Twins , Summoned to Another World for a Second Time ) is directing the anime at KONAMI animation with Haruta Segi as the assistant director. Gigaemon Ichikawa ( Himitsu no AiPri , PuniRunes three seasons) is in charge of series scripts, Yūki Itō ( Mob Psycho 100 II OAV key animator) and Kana Tosaoka ( Kantai Collection -KanColle- film in-between animator) are designing the characters. Naoki Endō ( Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club , Nijiyon Animation ) is composing the music, and Hiromi Kikuta ( Aikatsu! , Blue Period , Haikyu!! ) is directing the sound.

The additional staff members are:

• Color Key Artist: Ryōta Katsuta, Maki Yamamoto

• Art Setting: Barnstorm Design Labo

• Art Director: Hiroshi Gōroku

• Background Art: Makaria

• Compositing Director of Photography: Takashi Ōde

• Editing: Masayuki Kurosawa

The anime will premiere on October 6 on Tokyo MX at 9:25 p.m. JST, then on the BS NTV , and MBS channels, and will run for two consecutive cours . The anime will also stream on ABEMA , d Anime Store , and U-NEXT after its broadcast. HIDIVE will stream the anime as it airs. The anime will also hold an advance screening event for its first three episodes on September 22 at the esports TOKYO BAY studio.

Minamino launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2019, and ended its run there in 2021. Hobby Japan started publishing the novels with illustration by Jishaku in September 2022. Katana Canata started drawing the novels' illustration from its third volume in 2023. (The anime credits both illustrators for the original character designs.) Hobby Japan published the 11th volume on June 1.

Kabuto Kodai launched the novels' manga adaptation on Square Enix 's Manga UP! service in 2022. Square Enix published the manga's first compiled book volume in May 2023, and the eighth volume on February 6. Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service publishes the manga in English.
author: ANN

title: Magic Repo Man Anime's 2nd English-Subtitled Trailer Reveals More Cast, Theme Songs
content:
TV Asahi presented the second English-subtitled trailer, another cast member, and the theme song artists for the television anime of Masakichi and Shingou Iijima 's Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I'll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest! (Kashita Maryoku wa [Ribo Harai] de Kyōsei Chōshū ~Yōzumi to Party Tsuihōsareta Ore wa, Kawaii Support Yōsei to Issho ni Toritateta Maryoku wo Unyōshite Saikyō wo Mezasu.~) manga on Tuesday. Idol group BUDDiiS performs the opening theme song "Risk rate," and artist Kotani performs the ending theme song "Vase" (Iremono).

Daisuke Namikawa joins the cast as Roger, the leader of the A-rank party "Meteor Shower."

Seven Seas describes the story:

If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out? Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!

The anime will premiere on October 4 on the NUMAnimation programming block on TV Asahi and 23 affiliated channels at 25:30 (effectively, Sundays at 1:30 a.m.), and then later on BS Asahi .

The anime will star:

• Reiji Kawashima as Lent

• Emiri Katō as Empee

• Daiki Hamano as Guy

• Akira Sekine as Misa

• Yū Kobayashi as Elle

• Risae Matsuda as Linka

Takahiro Tamano ( Baban Baban Ban Vampire , The Foolish Angel Dances with the Devil assistant director) is directing the anime at Synergy SP . Ryūsuke Mori is in charge of series scripts, and Kazue Mori ( The Yakuza's Guide to Babysitting sub-character designer) is designing the characters.

Haruko Nobori is the color key artist, Kazuhiro Arai is the art director, Yōhei Konishi is the compositing director of photography, Masaki Sakamoto serves as editor, Keiko Urakami as sound director, and Kow Otani as musical composer.

Seven Seas licensed the manga and will release the second volume on October 13.

Masakichi launched the story on the Kakuyomu website in 2022. The story's manga adaptation by Iijima launched on BookLive and Flex Comics ' Comic Ark isekai manga label in 2023. The manga's second part is an original story completely different from the story posted on Kakuyomu. The manga's fifth compiled book volume will ship on November 14.
author: ANN

Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!
The anime will premiere on October 4 on the NUMAnimation programming block on TV Asahi and 23 affiliated channels at 25:30 (effectively, Sundays at 1:30 a.m.), and then later on BS Asahi .

Takahiro Tamano ( Baban Baban Ban Vampire , The Foolish Angel Dances with the Devil assistant director) is directing the anime at Synergy SP . Ryūsuke Mori is in charge of series scripts, and Kazue Mori ( The Yakuza's Guide to Babysitting sub-character designer) is designing the characters.

Haruko Nobori is the color key artist, Kazuhiro Arai is the art director, Yōhei Konishi is the compositing director of photography, Masaki Sakamoto serves as editor, Keiko Urakami as sound director, and Kow Otani as musical composer.
Seven Seas licensed the manga and will release the second volume on October 13.

Masakichi launched the story on the Kakuyomu website in 2022. The story's manga adaptation by Iijima launched on BookLive and Flex Comics ' Comic Ark isekai manga label in 2023. The manga's second part is an original story completely different from the story posted on Kakuyomu. The manga's fifth compiled book volume will ship on November 14.

title: Muse Asia Licenses The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Anime
content:
Muse Asia announced last Friday that it has licensed the second television anime season based on Nigojū and Umibōzu 's The Detective Is Already Dead ( Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. ) light novel series and will begin streamming it in October.

The anime will debut in Japan on October 7.

The anime's second season was first announced in July 2022. Kadokawa previously announced that the second season would air in July, but then delayed it to October.

The returning cast includes:

• Arata Nagai as Kimihiko Kimizuka

• Saki Miyashita as Siesta

• Ayana Taketatsu as Nagisa Natsunagi

• Kanon Takao as Yui Saikawa

• Saho Shirasu as Charlotte Arisaka Anderson

• Mai Fuchigami as Fūbi Kase

• Yumiri Hanamori as Hell

• Maria Naganawa as Alicia

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Kōmori

• Saki Miyashita as Noches

New cast members include Akari Komiyama as Mia Whitlock and Nobuhiko Okamoto as Scarlet.

Manabu Kurihara returns to direct the second season at ENGI . Deko Akao is again in charge of series scripts, and Yōsuke Itō is again designing the characters.

40mP is composing the anime's music, along with composing, arranging, and writing the lyrics for the theme songs. Kōme performs the opening "Kono Shinzō ni Hanabata wo" (A Bouquet for This Heart), and Kagura Nana returns to perform the ending "Hakuchumu" (Daydreams).

The anime's first season premiered with a one-hour special in July 2021 and aired for 12 episodes. Muse Asia streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

title: Ani-One Asia Streams New Magic Knight Rayearth Anime
content:
Ani-One Asia announced last Friday that it will stream the new anime of CLAMP 's Magic Knight Rayearth manga in October. Ani-One Asia describes the anime:

While visiting Tokyo Tower on a field trip, Hikaru Shidou, Umi Ryuuzaki, and Fuu Hououji are suddenly summoned to another world called Cephiro. There, the three learn that Princess Emeraude, who has protected the peace and order of Cephiro, has been taken captive, plunging the world into crisis. Summoned by Princess Emeraude to save Cephiro, can these three girls truly become the legendary Magic Knights and rescue both the Princess and the world?

The anime will debut in Japan on October 7.

The anime's cast members include

• Ayane Sakura as Hikaru Shidō

• Rumi Ōkubo as Umi Ryūzaki

• Rie Takahashi as Fū Hōōji

• Saori Hayami as Emeraude

• Yūki Ono as Zagato

• Mika Kikuchi as Mokona

• Yūki Kaji as Clef

• Emiri Katō as Presea

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Ferio

Yui Miura (episode director for Ninja Kamui , Bullet/Bullet ) is making his series directorial debut with the anime, and E&H production is producing the anime. Shigeru Murakoshi ( Zombie Land Saga , Ninja Kamui , Apocalypse Hotel ) is in charge of the series scripts. Satomi Watabe ( Escha Chron , Aikatsu Friends! ) is designing the characters. Yuki Kajiura , Takumi Ozawa , and Shiho Terada are composing the music. UNLIMITED PRODUCE by TMS is producing the project.

The creative circle CLAMP serialized the Magic Knight Rayearth manga in Kodansha 's Nakayoshi magazine from 1993 to 1996 with six volumes. The manga inspired two television anime seasons, the first running from October 1994 to March 1995, and the second season, titled Magic Knight Rayearth 2 , running from April to November 1995. The manga also inspired a three-episode 1997 original video anime project simply titled Rayearth , featuring an alternate retelling of the story.

title: Crunchyroll Adds Saga of Tanya the Evil: Operation Desert Pasta Anime Special in India
content:
Crunchyroll began streaming in India on Wednesday The Saga of Tanya the Evil: Operation Desert Pasta special . The anime special is streaming in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub .

The 17-minute short debuted during a livestreamed event for the franchise in June 2021.

Saga of Tanya the Evil II ( Yōjo Senki II ), the anime's second season , debuted on the AT-X channel on July 8 and also runs on Tokyo MX , Sun TV , KBS Kyoto , BS11 , and TV Aichi . Crunchyroll is streaming the season in India as it airs in Japan. Amazon Prime Video 's Anime Times is also streaming the season.

Like the first season, the second season inspired a "Yōjo Shenki 2" (The Shaga [sic] of Tanya the Evil 2) mini-anime. Each mini anime episode runs immediately after each Saga of Tanya the Evil II episode on AT-X , and then streams on the Kadokawa Anime Channel on YouTube starting that Thursday at midnight JST for two weeks. The new mini anime also features the new members of the Salamander Kampfgruppe.

The second season was announced in June 2021.

The television anime adaptation of the novels premiered in January 2017. Ani-One Asia 's YouTube channel streamed the first season in India in November 2020.

The anime also had a film that opened in Japan in February 2019, with a returning staff and cast.

Yen Press licensed both the original Saga of Tanya the Evil light novel series and Chika Tōjō 's manga adaptation, and it describes the story:

High above the blood- and mud-soaked trenches, a young girl pits herself against army mages in high stakes aerial duels with bullets, spells, and bayonets. Her name is Tanya Degurechaff and she is the Devil of the Rhine, one of the greatest soldiers the Empire has ever seen! But inside her mind lives a ruthless, calculating ex-salaryman who enjoyed a peaceful life in Japan until he woke up in a war-torn world. Reborn as a destitute orphaned girl with nothing to her name but memories of a previous life, Tanya will do whatever it takes to survive, even if she can find it only behind the barrel of a gun!

Carlo Zen and Shinobu Shinotsuki launched the novel series in 2013, and Kadokawa published the 14th volume in September 2023. Tōjo launched the manga in Monthly Comp Ace in 2016, Kadokawa published the 35th volume on August 25.
